name: WaiAir — Live Flight Board
subtitle: Gates · Delays · Track Flights
promotionalText: Free for everything you need to travel. Live gates, delays, baggage and alerts — no tricks. Pro is for unlimited tracking and smart timeline alerts.
description:
WaiAir is free for everything you need to travel.
Live gates, delays, baggage belts, notifications —
all free, no tricks.

Pro is for frequent travelers who want
unlimited tracking and smart timeline alerts.

See real-time departures and arrivals for any airport worldwide.
Track your flight and get notified the moment boarding starts.

FREE — EVERYTHING YOU NEED TO TRAVEL:
- Live departure & arrival boards worldwide
- Gate info and gate changes in the app
- Baggage belt in the app
- Push notifications for boarding, gate changes and delays
- Live Activity on the lock screen
- Home screen widget
- Weather at your destination
- Currency exchange
- After-landing card
- Connection checker (2 checks per day)
- Track up to 3 flights
- Dark mode
- 10,000+ airports worldwide

WAIAIR PRO — FOR FREQUENT TRAVELERS:
- Track unlimited flights
- Faster updates (every 30 seconds)
- Smart flight timeline alerts
- Flight history (last 50 flights)
- Follow multiple airports
- Baggage info before landing
- Live aircraft position on the map
- Unlimited connection checks
- No ads ever

Perfect for frequent travelers, airport meeters,
and anyone who wants live flight information at their fingertips.

Available for airports worldwide including Schiphol, Phuket,
Bangkok Suvarnabhumi, Singapore Changi, and 10,000+ more.
